This was a thoroughly unpleasant experience involving outright deception.
I bought a JBL speaker on AliExpress (order 3064127943454575) and received a crude counterfeit. The seller claimed it was the "Hong Kong version." I opened a dispute, and AliExpress ruled that I would get a refund upon returning the item. I shipped the item back at my own expense. Afterward, AliExpress changed its decision and demanded proof that the item was counterfeit—proof I no longer had, since I had already sent the speaker back. As a result, I was cheated out of both the cost of the speaker and the return shipping fees. To top it off, they completely removed the order and the associated correspondence from my purchase history.

reviews.review_text:
Do not trust AliExpress, even if the product is sold under their "Choice" program which claims to guarantee a premium experience and free returns. It is a complete scam.

They try to save their public image by replying to Trustpilot reviews, pretending they want to help and asking you to send further email evidence. But it is just a PR stunt to look good in public. I did exactly what they asked: I replied to their specific customer care email within hours, providing a public Google Drive link containing clear video evidence of the transit damage and photos proving the item is a total counterfeit (the seller listed a generic mosquito racket as an original LENOVO product, which doesn't even exist). 

The result? Exactly the same automated, copy-paste rejection. They completely ignored the irrefutable evidence, refused the refund, and told me to contact the seller. This seller has literally mocked me in chat with smiling emojis because they know they are fully protected by AliExpress to scam international buyers.

Even though the product was sold with a "Free Return" guarantee, AliExpress tried to force me to pay 150 CHF for international shipping from Switzerland to China out of my own pocket for a broken, fake 29 CHF item. 

Order ID: 3072847636215035

AliExpress absolutely does not care about its customers. They pretend to look helpful in public review replies, but privately they protect scammers and break their own contract terms. I am currently finalizing a formal fraud chargeback with my Swiss bank to get my money back by force. Avoid this platform at all costs!

reviews.review_title: I ordered a product on AliExpress…
reviews.review_text:
I ordered a product on AliExpress (Order 3058621170597815). The item was defective, so I requested a return in October 2025. AliExpress provided return instructions, and I shipped the package back to China via DHL (tracking: CY731194892DE), paying 25,49€ for shipping.
On 27.01.2026, the package was rejected by Chinese customs and returned to Germany. Because of this, DHL charged me an additional 10,00€ fee. Total shipping costs I paid: 35,49€ — for a return that never reached the seller due to AliExpress incorrect return address/instructions.
I contacted AliExpress multiple times. Their chat agent acknowledged the problem, escalated my case (Case ID: 2053808438878684), and confirmed that my earlier chargeback (24.09.2025) covered only the product price, not shipping costs. The agent promised a senior team would review my refund request within 1–3 working days.
Instead of a refund, I received automated emails telling me to "contact the logistics provider" and that AliExpress "can't handle the refund." This is unacceptable — the customs rejection was caused by AliExpress, not DHL or me. Under EU consumer protection law, the seller is responsible for costs arising from incorrect return instructions.
AliExpress has ignored my evidence, wasted my time, and refuses to take responsibility for their own error. I demand a full refund of 35,49€ for shipping costs caused by their mistake.
